mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS is low (<= 1.5%) but S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days when both series exceed historical thresholds.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 450000 but S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions characterized by low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong GDP growth (qoq > 2.0%), equity markets anticipate sustained corporate earnings, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 4.0% and GDPC1 growth (qoq) > 2.0%, S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) reflects expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 105.0 but S&P 500 produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A robust labor market (PAYEMS > 145000) indicates strong consumer spending power, driving immediate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS is high (above 145000) but S&P 500 produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245.0) triggers central bank tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 245.0 but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint strength in industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) and housing starts (HOUST > 1000) signals a synchronized supply-demand expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 105.0 and HOUST > 1000 but S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
